evals.prompt: Extract the transcript and metadata from a YouTube video URL. Summarize the key points.
evals.expected_output: Video metadata (title, duration, channel). Full transcript text. Bullet-point summary of 5 key takeaways.
assertions: Summary with at least 3 key points provided

evals.prompt: Generate a podcast script from the paper at evals/files/paper.pdf. Format as a 2-person conversation, approximately 5 minutes long.
evals.expected_output: Podcast script with HOST and GUEST labeled turns. Covers introduction, main contributions, methodology, results, and implications. Approximately 700-1000 words.
assertions: Script has HOST and GUEST turns
